## Ingredients
- chicken (raw; grillable from raw)
- bun bot (ready to use)
- bun top (ready to use)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 1 (at most 1 grill action running at once)

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- chicken must be grilled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. bun bot
  2. grilled chicken
  3. bun top
domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and 
      (at start (raw ?i)) 
      (at start (grill_free))
    )
    :effect (and 
      (at start (not (raw ?i))) 
      (at start (not (grill_free))) 
      (at end (grilled ?i)) 
      (at end (stackable ?i)) 
      (at end (grill_free))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and 
      (at start (stackable bun_bot))
      (at start (ready bun_bot))
    )
    :effect (and 
      (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) 
      (at end (stacked bun_bot))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and 
      (at start (stackable chicken))
      (at start (grilled chicken))
      (at start (stacked bun_bot))
    )
    :effect (and 
      (at start (not (stackable chicken))) 
      (at end (stacked chicken))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and 
      (at start (stackable bun_top))
      (at start (ready bun_top))
      (at start (stacked chicken))
    )
    :effect (and 
      (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) 
      (at end (stacked bun_top))
    )
  )
)
problem_pddl:
(define (problem chicken_burger)
  (:domain cooking)
  (:objects
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )
  (:init
    (raw chicken)
    (ready bun_bot)
    (stackable bun_bot)
    (ready bun_top)
    (stackable bun_top)
    (grill_free)
  )
  (:goal (and
    (grilled chicken)
    (stacked bun_bot)
    (stacked chicken)
    (stacked bun_top)
  ))
)

- plate (ready to use)

- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item. NOTE: some items must be marinated before they can be grilled (see ingredients).
- **cut** `<item>`  —  Chop a raw item on the cutting board. Takes 3 seconds. Produces a cut item.
- **marinate** `<item>`  —  Marinate a cut item. Takes 6 seconds. Produces a marinated item. The item must be cut first.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 1 (at most 1 grill action running at once)
- **cutting board**: capacity 1 (at most 1 cut action running at once)
- **marinator**: capacity 1 (at most 1 marinate action running at once)

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- chicken must be grilled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. plate
  2. grilled chicken
domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken plate - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (cut ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut ?i))) (at start (not (marinator_free))) (at end (marinated ?i)) (at end (marinator_free))))

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (marinated ?i))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action stack_plate
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable plate)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable plate))) (at end (stacked plate))))

  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken)) (at start (grilled chicken)) (at start (stacked plate)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken))) (at end (stacked chicken))))

  (:constants

  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (fryer_free))) (at end (fried ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action fry_potato13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)

    :effect (and (at start (not (cut potato13))) (at start (not (fryer_free))) (at end (fried potato13)) (at end (stackable potato13)) (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (boiler_free))) (at end (boiled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (boiler_free))))

## Ingredients
- feast plate (ready to use)
- patty #14 (raw; grillable from raw)
- salmon #14 (raw; grillable from raw)
- chicken #14 (raw; cuttable from raw; grillable after marinating) [must be cut, then marinated before grilling]
- tofu #14 (raw; cuttable from raw; grillable after marinating) [must be cut, then marinated before grilling]
- fish #14 (raw; fryable from raw)
- falafel #14 (raw; fryable from raw)
- potato #14 (raw; cuttable from raw; fryable after cut) [must be cut before frying]
- onion #14 (raw; cuttable from raw; fryable after cut) [must be cut before frying]
- yam #14 (raw; boilable from raw; mashable after boiling)
- turnip #14 (raw; boilable from raw; mashable after boiling)
- stock #14 (raw; boilable from raw)
- beans #14 (raw; boilable from raw)
- lettuce #14 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- tomato #14 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- cucumber #14 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- carrot #14 (raw; cuttable from raw)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item. NOTE: some items must be marinated before they can be grilled (see ingredients).
- **cut** `<item>`  —  Chop a raw item on the cutting board. Takes 3 seconds. Produces a cut item.
- **fry** `<item>`  —  Fry an item in a fryer. Takes 8 seconds. Produces a fried item. NOTE: some items must be cut before they can be fried (see ingredients).
- **boil** `<item>`  —  Boil an item. Takes 12 seconds. Produces a boiled item.
- **marinate** `<item>`  —  Marinate a cut item. Takes 6 seconds. Produces a marinated item. The item must be cut first.
- **mash** `<item>`  —  Mash a boiled item on the cutting board. Takes 4 seconds. Produces a mashed item. The item must be boiled first.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 3 (at most 3 grill actions running at once)
- **cutting board**: capacity 4 (at most 4 cut/mash actions running at once)
- **fryer**: capacity 3 (at most 3 fry actions running at once)
- **boiler**: capacity 3 (at most 3 boil actions running at once)
- **marinator**: capacity 3 (at most 3 marinate actions running at once)

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- patty #14 must be grilled
- salmon #14 must be grilled
- chicken #14 must be grilled
- tofu #14 must be grilled
- fish #14 must be fried
- falafel #14 must be fried
- potato #14 must be fried
- onion #14 must be fried
- yam #14 must be mashed
- turnip #14 must be mashed
- stock #14 must be boiled
- beans #14 must be boiled
- lettuce #14 must be cut
- tomato #14 must be cut
- cucumber #14 must be cut
- carrot #14 must be cut

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. feast plate

## Ingredients
- patty #05 (raw; grillable from raw)
- chicken #05 (raw; cuttable from raw; grillable after marinating) [must be cut, then marinated before grilling]
- fish #05 (raw; fryable from raw)
- potato #05 (raw; cuttable from raw; fryable after cut) [must be cut before frying]
- yam #05 (raw; boilable from raw; mashable after boiling)
- lettuce #05 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- stock #05 (raw; boilable from raw)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item. NOTE: some items must be marinated before they can be grilled (see ingredients).
- **cut** `<item>`  —  Chop a raw item on the cutting board. Takes 3 seconds. Produces a cut item.
- **fry** `<item>`  —  Fry an item in a fryer. Takes 8 seconds. Produces a fried item. NOTE: some items must be cut before they can be fried (see ingredients).
- **boil** `<item>`  —  Boil an item. Takes 12 seconds. Produces a boiled item.
- **marinate** `<item>`  —  Marinate a cut item. Takes 6 seconds. Produces a marinated item. The item must be cut first.
- **mash** `<item>`  —  Mash a boiled item on the cutting board. Takes 4 seconds. Produces a mashed item. The item must be boiled first.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 1 (at most 1 grill action running at once)
- **cutting board**: capacity 2 (at most 2 cut/mash actions running at once)
- **fryer**: capacity 1 (at most 1 fry action running at once)
- **boiler**: capacity 1 (at most 1 boil action running at once)
- **marinator**: capacity 1 (at most 1 marinate action running at once)

## Robot Constraints
Each action must be assigned to exactly one robot.
A robot can run at most one action at a time.
Available robots:
- robot1
- robot2

## Goal
Complete as much reward as possible by 24 seconds.
Candidate rewards:
- patty #05 as grilled: reward 9; cost protein=1
- chicken #05 as grilled: reward 14; cost protein=1, fresh=1
- fish #05 as fried: reward 8; cost protein=1, fryer_oil=1
- potato #05 as fried: reward 7; cost fryer_oil=1, fresh=1
- yam #05 as mashed: reward 10; cost root=1
- lettuce #05 as cut: reward 4; cost fresh=1
- stock #05 as boiled: reward 6; cost root=1

Inventory limits:
- protein: at most 2
- fryer_oil: at most 2
- root: at most 1
- fresh: at most 2

    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)

    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
